verdicts.reason: A: the magnifier icon is enlarged into a huge, pixelated focal point that competes with the headline. The search-box icon is lost, so the PPC bar has an empty box on the right. 'How to level up' is small, and the photo is jammed at the bottom with thin margins. Still, the order is correct (headline, PPC, ONLINE COURSE, photo), the orange brand is strong, and the text is readable. B: reading order is changed, with ONLINE COURSE above HOW TO LEVEL UP, so the message reads out of sequence. The photo is cropped into an odd oval-ish shape floating in a big empty white top area. The faint ghost magnifier at the bottom looks like an orphaned leftover. The text is small, and the PPC bar also has an empty box. The look is less orange-dominant and the original's feel is weakened. Both are flawed, but A keeps the hierarchy and brand better.
